purpose: 三版圆角矩形绘图组件设计示例；供讨论，不代表已实现的界面

variants.name: 轻量描边
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop application UI design proposal, polished sharp screenshot, 1600x1000 landscape.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: an existing Craken desktop app screenshot. Preserve its recognizable shell: narrow dark Chinese top menu with "Craken 文件 编辑 选择 查看 转到 运行 终端 帮助", thin left and right activity icon rails, and bottom status bar. Keep the existing app's restrained engineering-tool aesthetic. Replace the two empty input/output canvases with ONE large data-structure drawing canvas occupying the middle-left 75%, and repurpose the right inner sidebar as a simple selected-node inspector. This is a concept screenshot, not a marketing poster.
Exact existing app palette: canvas #0d1117; surfaces #161b22; raised #21262d; borders #30363d; primary text #e6edf3; muted text #8b949e; focus blue #58a6ff; neutral selection #383d43 with outline #5a697e; green #238636 only for a small action button. UI typography Microsoft YaHei UI / Segoe UI, values and identifiers in Cascadia Mono / Consolas. Thin crisp rules, no gradients, no glass, no glow, no oversized headings, no photographic props, no 3D.
MANDATORY: EVERY data node including tree nodes, array cells, empty/null nodes and group boxes must be a ROUNDED RECTANGLE; NO circular, oval, diamond or pill data nodes. Use a consistent modest 6px corner radius for data nodes.
The drawing canvas has a slim header titled "数据结构" with subtle tool buttons "自动布局" "适应画布" and a small "100%" control. Show a neat binary tree in a thin group frame titled "tree". Exact data topology and labels: root value 32; left child 18; right child 47; children of 18 are 9 and 24; children of 47 are 39 and 56. Seven total rectangular nodes, centered evenly in three levels, no overlaps. Every node shows small "Node" and a clear main numeric value. The selected node is 18, with blue outline; the root-to-18 edge is blue. Other edges thin muted gray with tiny arrowheads, right-angle bends with softened corners, connect exactly to rectangle edges. Do not draw floating circular connection ports.
Beneath the tree, a second unobtrusive group titled "values" shows FIVE separate small rounded-rectangle array cells containing 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, with external muted index captions [0], [1], [2], [3], [4]. The value 30 is selected using the same blue focus style. Keep good visual breathing room.
The right sidebar uses the existing app's compact layout: heading "节点详情", small type "Node", large value "18", thin separators and three key/value rows "value  18", "left  9", "right  24". A small green button labeled "定位源码". Below it include a compact horizontal row of three tiny rounded rectangle state samples labeled "默认" "悬停" "选中". No extra data graphs or invented controls.
Keep all visible text legible and exact, use no lorem ipsum. Bottom status left "就绪", right "7 个节点 · 6 条连线". A subtle small variant identifier belongs at the left of the canvas header, no large external title.

VARIANT A — "A · 轻量描边". Most faithful to the current app. Flat low-contrast nodes with fill #161b22, thin #30363d one-pixel outlines, no shadow, 6px corner radius. Each tree node is compact and balanced, small muted "Node" top-left and numeric value centered with calm hierarchy; spacious canvas around nodes. Selected 18 has a crisp #58a6ff outline with only a very subtle darker blue fill. Group frames are barely visible. Minimal neutral gray connectors. Flat and quiet. Absolutely no elevated card effect.
